assertions.title: Copytruncate rotation preserves writer file descriptor

steps.action: Start a continuous writer to fast.log in isolated MLX_STACK_HOME and grow file above threshold
steps.expected: File exceeds configured rotation size without stopping writer
steps.observed: fast.log reached 1,312,890 bytes while writer stayed active

steps.expected: Rotation creates fast.log.1.gz and truncates fast.log in-place
steps.observed: CLI reported `✓ fast: rotated`; archive created; current log truncated then reused

steps.action: Keep writer running after rotation and inspect counters
steps.expected: Writer continues appending via same open descriptor
steps.observed: Writer remained alive; post-rotation counters continued past archived max (archive max 8999, current min 9200)

steps.action: Run `config list/get` for log-max-size-mb and log-max-files
steps.observed: Defaults present in config list and get output

steps.action: Set both keys with valid values
steps.observed: `log-max-size-mb=1` and `log-max-files=5` accepted and shown as user-set
All invalid values rejected with error messages and non-zero exit codes

steps.action: Configure max-files=5 and perform 6 forced rotations on fast.log
steps.expected: Archives shift with .1.gz as newest and old archives capped at 5
steps.observed: After 6 rotations, only fast.log.1.gz..fast.log.5.gz existed; fast.log.6.gz absent

steps.expected: .1 is most recent, then descending recency

steps.observed: All retained archives decompressed successfully during marker inspection

assertions.title: start_service opens log in append mode

steps.action: Inspect process.py start_service log open mode
steps.expected: Log file opened with append mode `a`

steps.action: Start same service name twice with different output markers
steps.expected: Second start appends without wiping prior content

steps.action: Rotate empty.log and below-threshold small.log via CLI
steps.observed: CLI reported `no rotation needed` for both; no .gz archives created

steps.action: Invoke rotate_log on missing file path
steps.observed: rotate_log(missing.log) returned False with no error

frictions.description: Negative numeric values for `config set` require `--` delimiter (e.g., `... log-max-size-mb -- -5`) or Click parses them as options.
frictions.resolution: Used `--` delimiter for negative-value validation commands.

frictions.description: With an actively writing process, post-rotation log size is not near-zero for long; it grows immediately after truncate.
frictions.resolution: Validated copytruncate by confirming writer continuity and monotonic counter progression across archive/current logs.

summary: Tested 5 assertions (VAL-LOG-001..005): 5 passed, 0 failed, 0 blocked, 0 skipped.
